name: List name (owner for GitHub lists)
type: github-pr | form | email | forum | account | none
accepts: Who it is for: platforms, product types, minimum discount, product age.
cost_note: Optional. What the paid options are, in words.
how_to_submit: The route in one or two sentences, with the submit URL.
entry_format: Optional. The row, file or field list, close to verbatim.
rules: Optional. One rule per string: what gets an entry closed, limits, position rules, bot checks.
status: live | live-no-current-edition | dead | copy | paid-only | not-a-fit | no-submission-route | could-not-read
status_note: Optional. One line of evidence for the status.
recommended_for: Only when recommended is true: what kind of product, in a few words from the list's own rules. The evidence (an entry got in on <date>) goes in status_note.
